pairs: Putasne est aliquis qui remanserit de domo Saul,
“Do you think that there could be anyone left from the house of Saul,
ut faciam cum eo misericordiam propter Jonathan?
so that I might show mercy to him because of Jonathan?”
Erat autem de domo Saul servus nomine Siba:
Now there was, from the house of Saul, a servant named Ziba.
quem cum vocasset rex ad se,
And when the king had called him to himself,
Numquid superest aliquis de domo Saul,
“Could there be anyone alive from the house of Saul,
ut faciam cum eo misericordiam Dei?
so that I may show the mercy of God to him?”
And Ziba said to the king,
“There is left alive a son of Jonathan,
And Ziba said to the king,
ait, in domo est Machir filii Ammiel,
he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel,
Misit ergo rex David, et tulit eum de domo Machir filii Ammiel, de Lodabar.
Therefore, king David sent and brought him from the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lodebar.
Cum autem venisset Miphiboseth filius Jonathæ filii Saul ad David,
And when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul,
had come to David, he fell upon his face,
quia faciens faciam in te misericordiam propter Jonathan patrem tuum,
For I will certainly show mercy to you because of your father Jonathan.
et restituam tibi omnes agros Saul patris tui:
And I will restore to you all the fields of your father Saul.
et tu comedes panem in mensa mea semper.
And you shall eat bread at my table always.”
quoniam respexisti super canem mortuum similem mei?
that you should look with favor upon a dead dog like me?”
Vocavit itaque rex Sibam puerum Saul,
And so, the king called Ziba, the servant of Saul,
et universam domum ejus, dedi filio domini tui.
and his entire house, I have given to the son of your lord.
And so, work the land for him,
et filii tui, et servi tui,
you and your sons and your servants.
et inferes filio domini tui cibos ut alatur:
And you shall bring in food for the son of your lord, for nourishment.
Miphiboseth autem filius domini tui comedet semper panem super mensam meam.
And Mephibosheth, the son of your lord, shall always eat bread at my table.”
Erant autem Sibæ quindecim filii, et viginti servi.
Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
And Ziba said to the king:
Sicut jussisti, domine mi rex, servo tuo,
“Just as my lord has ordered your servant,
et Miphiboseth comedet super mensam meam,
And Mephibosheth shall eat at my table,
like one of the sons of the king.”
Habebat autem Miphiboseth filium parvulum nomine Micha:
Now Mephibosheth had a young son whose name was Mica. Truly,
omnis vero cognatio domus Sibæ serviebat Miphiboseth.
all the kindred of the house of Ziba served Mephibosheth.
quia de mensa regis jugiter vescebatur:
For he was fed always from the table of the king.
And he was lame in both feet.
